english.note: Use this when someone keeps praising a person or thing with excessive enthusiasm, rather than when something physically flows out.

examples.english: After trying the restaurant’s signature dish, they gush with praise.
examples.traditional: 佢食完嗰間餐廳嘅招牌菜，就讚不絕口。
